items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: I've never heard any of his records.

ctx.x: It was not even what we were used to listening to. In other words, it was a new style. How would you describe the style? Strictly modernistic. Not modernistic, but I mean progressive.
He was like Sigildia in his time, but in general.
Yeah, exactly. You've heard his records? I've never heard any of his records.
